source.title: Claude hunt 2026-10-20 (angle: clock candles across the NY day), slot 11:30. Uniform rule, pre-registered on every half-hour 15-minute candle 10:30-14:30 (13:30 and 15:00 left out: already run as cl_pm_first_bar_cdl_ema_15 and cl_pm_1500_candle_ema_15): follow the slot's candle at its close only when it closes on its own side of the 20-bar EMA of 15-minute closes; stop at its other extreme, 1.5R, once a day. Why it should pay: intraday time-series momentum -- the side that has held the day (EMA20 of 15-minute closes, about the last five hours) is worked by institutions splitting big orders over the whole day (VWAP / TWAP schedules), so a candle that closes WITH that side at a clock turn is the schedule still executing, and the push carries past the candle's own range. Who loses: the mean-reversion traders and liquidity providers who fade the day's side at each clock turn and get run over by the next slice of the schedule. This slot: the London cash close (16:30 London = 11:30 ET); after it the US flows carry the day's side alone, and a with-trend candle shows they still do; the traders fading into the lunch turn pay.

entry.words: Only the 15-minute candle of 11:30-11:45 ET is read (the entry window 11:45-12:00 holds its close and no other). It closes up with a body of at least 0.1 x ATR(14) (any real candle, not a doji) and the close is above the 20-bar EMA of 15-minute closes: buy at its close; it closes down and below the EMA: sell. Stop at the candle's other extreme, target 1.5 times the stop distance. Once a day, flat 15:58.

not_run: THE FAMILY: win_candle / candle930 with start 11:30 is the plain form, but `taught check` refuses them outside nyam (it reads their passes at the default 09:30 start); displace with its floor k 0.1 and an entry window holding only this candle's close is the same candle follow (a candle with a body under 0.1 x ATR(14) counts as a doji: no trade).
THE GATE: the open layer's price_ema(20) on the 15-minute closes since 00:00 ET, read at the candle's close (above = long side, below = short side); a candle against it is no trade that day.
THE STOP: the candle's other extreme, floored at 0.25 x ATR when nearer.
THE CAP: one trade a day; the mid pass (11:00-13:30) is the only pass and the window holds one candle close.
THE HOLD: a trade that reaches neither stop nor target leaves on the clock at 15:58 ET (13:13 on an equity half day; on a half day a slot after the half-day cut-off places no trade).

RELATED ENTRIES ALREADY READ: the cl_disp15_*_allday sheets hold the big-bodied subset of these candles (10:00-15:00) on the build days; owner_jj_mom_allday_* and the first-bar sheets (owner_mid_first_bar_15: the 11:00 candle) had 3:1 walk-forwards read, so the test months are not wholly blind for candle-follow entries.
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage, $4 a round turn, tick replay).
THE TEST DAYS (2025-07-01 on) ARE NOT READ by this sheet: build days only.
FLAT: every trade is flat by 15:58 ET (13:13 on half days).
